description: Unicode ranges preserved when subsetting vendored fonts. Shared by scripts/fetch-fonts.mjs (which applies it) and src/lib/fonts/charset.ts (which tests it). Widening a range means re-running `pnpm fonts:fetch`.

ranges.name: Latin-1 Supplement
ranges.why: é ñ ü ç ø å ö ß — Western European names and the × symbol.

ranges.name: Latin Extended-A
ranges.why: ā ł đ ğ ş ı — Polish, Turkish, Baltic, Czech, Hungarian names.

ranges.name: Latin Extended-B
ranges.why: Romanian, Vietnamese base forms, and African Latin orthographies.

ranges.name: Greek and Coptic
ranges.why: Greek applicants' names. Present in all five source families.

ranges.name: General Punctuation
ranges.why: En dash (used in every date range), bullet, curly quotes, ellipsis.

ranges.name: Currency Symbols
ranges.why: ₹ € ₽ ₩ — quantified achievements are often monetary, and the audience is global.

extras.name: TRADE MARK SIGN
extras.why: Appears in product and certification names.
